title: Seizure
immediate_warning: Clear the area around the person to prevent injury.

immediate_warning_translations.en: Clear the area around the person to prevent injury.
immediate_warning_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Clear the area around the person to prevent injury.
immediate_warning_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Clear the area around the person to prevent injury.
immediate_warning_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Clear the area around the person to prevent injury.
immediate_warning_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Clear the area around the person to prevent injury.

description: A seizure is a sudden, uncontrolled electrical disturbance in the brain.

description_translations.en: A seizure is a sudden, uncontrolled electrical disturbance in the brain.
description_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] A seizure is a sudden, uncontrolled electrical disturbance in the brain.
description_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] A seizure is a sudden, uncontrolled electrical disturbance in the brain.
description_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] A seizure is a sudden, uncontrolled electrical disturbance in the brain.
description_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] A seizure is a sudden, uncontrolled electrical disturbance in the brain.

steps.instruction: Ease the person to the floor and clear the area of hard or sharp objects.

instruction_translations.en: Ease the person to the floor and clear the area of hard or sharp objects.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Ease the person to the floor and clear the area of hard or sharp objects.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Ease the person to the floor and clear the area of hard or sharp objects.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Ease the person to the floor and clear the area of hard or sharp objects.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Ease the person to the floor and clear the area of hard or sharp objects.

steps.instruction: Place something soft and flat, like a folded jacket, under their head.

instruction_translations.en: Place something soft and flat, like a folded jacket, under their head.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Place something soft and flat, like a folded jacket, under their head.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Place something soft and flat, like a folded jacket, under their head.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Place something soft and flat, like a folded jacket, under their head.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Place something soft and flat, like a folded jacket, under their head.

steps.instruction: Turn them gently onto one side. This helps keep the airway clear.

instruction_translations.en: Turn them gently onto one side. This helps keep the airway clear.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Turn them gently onto one side. This helps keep the airway clear.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Turn them gently onto one side. This helps keep the airway clear.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Turn them gently onto one side. This helps keep the airway clear.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Turn them gently onto one side. This helps keep the airway clear.

steps.instruction: Time the seizure. If it lasts longer than 5 minutes, call emergency services.

instruction_translations.en: Time the seizure. If it lasts longer than 5 minutes, call emergency services.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Time the seizure. If it lasts longer than 5 minutes, call emergency services.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Time the seizure. If it lasts longer than 5 minutes, call emergency services.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Time the seizure. If it lasts longer than 5 minutes, call emergency services.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Time the seizure. If it lasts longer than 5 minutes, call emergency services.

steps.instruction: Stay with them until the seizure ends and they are fully awake and aware.

instruction_translations.en: Stay with them until the seizure ends and they are fully awake and aware.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Stay with them until the seizure ends and they are fully awake and aware.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Stay with them until the seizure ends and they are fully awake and aware.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Stay with them until the seizure ends and they are fully awake and aware.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Stay with them until the seizure ends and they are fully awake and aware.

do_not: Do not hold the person down or try to stop their movements.
Do not put anything in their mouth.
Do not offer food or water until they are fully alert.
